catalog.title: Windows 11 client checks for BSI IT-Grundschutz and Grundschutz++
catalog.description: Read-only checks for a Windows 11 client. Requirement ids are copied from published BSI documents. Every windows11_carryover value is unverified because the setting values come from the Windows 10 Hilfsmittel.
catalog.applicability_note: Concrete values are carried over from Hilfsmittel zur Umsetzung der Anforderungen des IT-Grundschutz-Kompendiums fuer Windows-Clients, version 1.0, 20 February 2025, written for Windows 10 version 21H2 and later. BSI has not published a Windows 11 settings matrix. SYS.2.2.3 in the IT-Grundschutz-Kompendium Edition 2023 applies to Windows 10 and Windows 11. SiSyPHuS hardening checklists published by BSI address Windows 10 LTSC 2019 (1809). There is no published BSI Windows 11 SiSyPHuS matrix, so v0.1 does not score one.
